assumptions.height_and_angles: Estimated from the mount measurements and vehicle roof height; applied symmetrically
assumptions.horizontal_fov: ELP-USBGS1200P01-H110 nominal HFOV of 112 degrees; effective field of view in the 1280x720 recording mode is unmeasured
assumptions.optics: Square pixels, centered principal point, zero lens distortion and zero roll in upright saved frames
assumptions.plane: Flat ground; points on vehicles and barriers may be projected incorrectly
assumptions.origins: User-reported 0.875 m lateral lens spacing, equal forward position and centered mount. Origin is on the vehicle centerline at the camera row; not the axle or GPS antenna.
assumptions.max_range: 25 m is a display and analysis cutoff, not validated range
